title: Jamaica's National Heroes
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Seven brave Jamaicans who changed our history!
steps: Jamaica has SEVEN national heroes who fought for freedom and a better Jamaica.
NANNY of the Maroons — our only female hero — led her people to freedom in the mountains.
Sam Sharpe and Paul Bogle stood up against slavery and unfairness. George William Gordon spoke up for the poor.
Marcus Garvey taught Black pride worldwide. Norman Manley and Alexander Bustamante helped Jamaica become independent in 1962!

questions.prompt: How many national heroes does Jamaica have?
Who is Jamaica's only FEMALE national hero?
